newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Labour appoints two Treasury ministers.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Labour appoints two Treasury ministers.

text.p: Britain's new Labour government announced two Treasury ministerial appointments on Monday, a Downing Street official said.

Dawn Primarolo, MP for Bristol South since 1987, is named Financial Secretary at the Treasury, while Helen Liddell, whose appointment to the Treasury was announced on Sunday, is to be Economic Secretary.
Liddell had been Scottish affairs spokeswoman while Primarolo was a Treasury spokeswoman.
